answer: Weight an identity only by how many genuinely distinct counterparties it has served, not by how many accounts it owns: each new counterparty adds a ripple of credit, but repeat dealings with the same cluster add almost nothing. A nebula of self-dealing puppets therefore earns only one cluster worth of weight, while honest agents accumulate diverse partners. To fake diversity, an attacker must recruit or buy real, independent users, paying a glacier-sized recruitment bill for every extra vote.
